title: SOLO PINGS IN ALL THREE VIEWS
why: His pick 46: middle mouse pinging did not work in one player. Mouse, N and d-up tap now use the existing party marker, sound and 10 second lifetime alone too. Local enemy references follow unnumbered solo enemies; map and minimap refresh positions and expiry before drawing. Party messages and share-by-drop pings keep their existing path. Playtest watch: in the smooth look, ping an enemy alone, move between world, minimap and full map, and confirm the mark follows for 10 seconds then clears. Tap d-up to ping and hold it to open the map. In two windows, confirm both players still see each other ping and a dropped item still marks only the other window.
now: Solo mouse, N and pad pings show in the world, minimap and full map and follow an enemy for 10 seconds.
